name: Porsche 992 Turbo S
description: The Porsche 911 Turbo S (992) represents the pinnacle of the eighth-generation 911 lineup, unveiled in 2020. Powered by a twin-turbocharged 3.8-liter flat-six engine producing 650 hp and 800 Nm of torque, the Turbo S features larger VTG turbochargers with electrically adjustable wastegates, piezo fuel injection, and a new charge air cooling system for improved efficiency and throttle response. Power is delivered through Porsche's 8-speed PDK dual-clutch transmission to the sophisticated all-wheel-drive system with Porsche Traction Management, enabling a 0-100 km/h sprint in just 2.7 seconds and a top speed of 330 km/h. The 992 Turbo S features wider rear bodywork, active aerodynamics, and rear-axle steering for enhanced stability and agility.
author: Ceky Performance
